text: Strong fuel smell right after filling up; pump nozzle kept clicking off while refuelling. Smell fades by next morning.

Rubbing sound heard only between 40 km/h and 60 km/h. The rear brakes and the area were fully inspected visually (2026-10-23) and showed no sign of rubbing. Rear passenger anti-sway bar end link was replaced the same day. Time of day, whether the sound is still present after the work, and odometer not given.

Morning of 2026-10-23: the car does not auto-unlock on door-handle touch with the key fob in hand; it unlocks only with the fob's unlock button (passive entry fails, fob RF works). Time of day approximate (not stated). Outcome not recorded here: a research report exists from another session (no Stelvio-specific TSB found); ask the owner whether it was resolved.

Rear-left window (behind the driver) stops part way in BOTH directions, up and down; no bounce-back/reversal, it just stops. Ignition on, engine off, operated during the B1176-97 test. BCM re-read straight after (CUORE ~13:45): B1176-97 still status 0x0C (pending+confirmed), NOT failed this operation cycle, so this stop did not set the code.
DEMO: rough idle for about a minute after a cold start, engine warning light once. Normal when warm.
DEMO: loses power when overtaking at motorway speed, boost warning once, faint hiss under load.
